title: Platform revenue
intro: What MarketLink itself earns, and from which stalls. This is a different number from the money the markets take, and the two are never added together.

export.title: Export started
export.text: The CSV covers the period on screen.

scope.title: Charging Farmers is not in the SRS.
scope.text: Everything on this screen depends on a revenue model the requirements do not describe, and on money the platform cannot yet take.

gmv.title: The markets took {{gmv}} in {{month}}. MarketLink never touches it.
gmv.text: Customers pay their stall in cash at pickup. The {{total}} above is what stalls paid MarketLink for position, which is {{pct}}% of the market total.

perDay.title: Earned per day
perDay.note: In thousands of ₫. Income is lumpy because a pin is bought on one day and runs for several.
perDay.caption: Platform revenue per day in {{now}} against {{prev}}, in thousands of dong

sources.title: Where it came from
sources.note: {{count}} sources, adding to the period total
sources.caption: Each source of revenue in {{now}} against {{prev}}, in thousands of dong

whoPays.title: Who pays
whoPays.note: {{paying}} of {{total}} approved stalls paid something in {{month}}
whoPays.free: Three stalls paid nothing and still sold. That is the design: listing and selling are free, and paying only buys position.

credit.title: Credit
credit.owedNote: ₫ of pins and listings not yet used
credit.note: Stalls top up with the team, an admin enters the credit, and it is spent as they promote. Money already taken but not yet spent is money the platform still owes in placement.
